CustomField.description: When checked, exposes the Delete row action on Repeater and Table sections. Passed as allow-delete to c-flow-form-repeat / c-flow-data-table. Button text comes from Delete Action Button Label; for Table sections the confirmation modal uses Table Delete Action Modal Title/Subtitle/Body. Subject to the Min limit.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Turn on to let users delete rows from this repeater or table. Set the button label with Delete Action Button Label; deletion is blocked below the Min row count.
CustomField.label: Enable Delete Action
